title: PracMHBench: Re-evaluating Model-Heterogeneous Federated Learning Based on Practical Edge Device Constraints
problem: Model-heterogeneous federated learning (allowing different model architectures per device) is more practical than homogeneous FL, but existing algorithms have not been rigorously evaluated against real edge device constraints and resource limitations.
motivation: Edge devices have heterogeneous capabilities and resource constraints; model-heterogeneous FL better matches practical deployments, but without systematic evaluation on realistic hardware, algorithm selection remains ad-hoc.
method: PracMHBench constructs a system platform to evaluate model-heterogeneous FL algorithms under practical edge device constraints, classifying diverse heterogeneity algorithms and testing on multiple data tasks and resource constraint scenarios.
key_novelty: First system platform enabling comprehensive evaluation of model-heterogeneous FL algorithms under realistic edge device constraints with multi-dimensional performance analysis.
contributions: PracMHBench evaluation platform for model-heterogeneous FL under practical edge constraints
Classification of model heterogeneity algorithms and their performance under varied data/resource scenarios
Systematic evaluation providing guidance for algorithm selection in resource-constrained edge deployments

metrics.other: algorithm applicability patterns under edge constraints

limitations: Specific performance numbers and algorithm comparisons not provided in abstract.
primary_theme: Benchmarking model-heterogeneous federated learning on edge devices
